CPQJSReady.notes: Starting with 21B this is the recommended way to call JavaScript code in the footer.

CPQJS.actionExists.notes: Returns true if the provided action exists.

CPQJS.isConfig.notes: Returns true on a configuration page.

CPQJS.isJet.notes: Returns true on a JET page.

CPQJS.onActionComplete.notes: Calls the handler function when the action completes.

CPQJS.onAttributeChange.notes: Calls the handler function when the attribute changes.

CPQJS.openPopup.notes: Opens a popup with specified content and title.

CPQJS.performAction.notes: Calls the execution of the action.

CPQJS.setAttributeState.notes: Sets the state for the attribute to hide ({visible:false}), read-only ({updatable:false}).

CPQJS.attributeExists.notes: Checks if the attribute exists and returns true if it does.

CPQJS.getTableInfo.notes: Returns an object containing the listed values in a table or Line Item Grid. `lineItemGrid` returns the line item grid.

CPQJS.isCommerce.notes: Returns true on the Commerce page.

CPQJS.onTableLoaded.notes: Calls the handler function when the table is loaded. 'lineItemGrid' is the variable name for the line item grid.

CPQJS.tableExists.notes: Checks if the attribute exists and returns true if it does. 'lineItemGrid' is the variable name for the line item grid.
